data.name: CLEARANCE: S-7
data.detailed_description:
Eight days. One mountain. No backup.

"October 11th, 1989, 03:14 in the morning — the barrier gave way." So ends one of the magnetic tapes from Š-7, a secret facility of the Czechoslovak State Security, hidden beneath a mountain since 1948. A month later, as the regime collapses above ground, they send you down. You are Lieutenant Tomáš Vlk, and your orders are clear: document, destroy the archives, deal with the surviving witnesses. Alone.

THE STORY

Š-7 ran for 36 years: 247 test subjects, three directors and one classified program — the Theta protocol. For years they kept something locked behind an isolation pod and studied it. One October morning in 1989, it answered for the first time — and got out. Prague wants Š-7 to have never existed, and sent you down to make sure of it. But the truth arrives in layers: first what they told you, then what you suspect, and finally what truly is. The deeper you descend, the clearer it becomes — the "failing" project never failed. It worked exactly as intended.

ALONE. ONLY MONSTERS.

One rule that never breaks: nothing in Š-7 is still alive. No companions, no friendly faces, no help. Your only company is corpses, more than thirty tapes and journals, voices on the radio and the telephone — and things that used to be scientists, guards and subjects. Isolation is the only certainty here.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

  • A prologue and 8 days

  • Authentic 1989 Czechoslovakia: an encrypted radio, bureaucracy and dread

  • Raw PS1/PS2 retro visuals where the darkness itself becomes the enemy

  • Scarce ammo, an axe, a pistol and firebombs — combat is a last resort, not a playstyle

  • 30+ tapes and dozens of documents that assemble the truth piece by piece

  • 5 different endings, decided by the single sentence you finally speak into the microphone

A HIERARCHY OF EVIL

What devours you is not the monster in the corridor. The subjects are victims. The scientists were only subordinates. The director sits in Prague. And you are the instrument. The question is: do you stay the instrument, or do you turn? CLEARANCE never tells you what is right. It only shows you who died because of what you said.

data.short_description: November 1989, Czechoslovakia. As a secret-police officer you descend into the hidden facility Š-7, ordered to burn the archives and silence the witnesses. But no one down there is still alive — only corpses, tapes, and things that used to be people. A retro survival horror about guilt and memory.

content_descriptors.notes:
CLEARENCE is a psychological horror game set in 1989 Czechoslovakia. It contains the following adult content that may not be suitable for all audiences:

VIOLENCE & BLOOD
• Realistic depiction of corpses (encountered as part of the investigative gameplay)
• Player character can die in scripted scares and during combat with hostile entities
• Use of a firearm against undead enemies (no torture, mutilation, or gore beyond standard horror conventions)
• Brief depictions of injuries and signs of off-screen violence in the story

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR
• Persistent atmosphere of dread, jump scares, and disturbing imagery
• A relentless stalker enemy that pursues the player
• Themes of paranoia, isolation, and the loss of self

LANGUAGE
• Czech profanity in spoken and written dialogue (intelligence-service banter, period-accurate)
• Crude language and occasional swearing

DARK THEMES
• Depictions of covert state security (StB) operations during the late communist era
• References to experimental medical/psychological programs conducted on detained subjects
• References to alcohol and tobacco consumption typical of the period (no on-screen drug use)

The game contains NO sexual content, NO nudity, NO sexual violence, NO content depicting minors, NO hate speech, NO real-world gambling, and NO real-money transactions.
